name: Meonotai
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Meonotai is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. He was the son of Othniel and the father of Ophrah. He is primarily known from genealogical lists and has no major narrative events associated with him in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Meonotai is listed as the son of Othniel in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, as part of the descendants of Kenaz.

keyEvents.title: Father of Ophrah
keyEvents.description: Meonotai became the father of Ophrah, who is mentioned in connection with Ge-Harashim (the Valley of Craftsmen).

keyEvents.title: Part of the Kenaz Clan
keyEvents.description: Through his father Othniel, Meonotai belonged to the Kenaz clan, a prominent family within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Valley of Craftsmen
keyEvents.description: The sons of Meonothai were associated with Geth-harashim, which means "valley of the craftsmen," suggesting that the family was involved in craftwork.
